# Tokens

## color

| css variable | value | use |
|---|---|---|
| `var(--bg)` | `#F5F4ED` | page background. Never #fff, never cool gray |
| `var(--surface)` | `#FAF9F5` | cards, code blocks, inputs, elevated paper |
| `var(--sand)` | `#E8E6DC` | secondary buttons, interactive fills |
| `var(--ink)` | `#141413` | primary text and focus ring. Not pure black |
| `var(--ink-soft)` | `#3D3D3A` | secondary text |
| `var(--olive)` | `#504E49` | quotes, captions, de-emphasized text |
| `var(--stone)` | `#6B6A64` | footnotes, meta |
| `var(--line)` | `#D9D6CC` | the one hairline, only when a boundary must be explicit |
| `var(--accent)` | `#1C3D32` | links, one primary button, overlines, key numbers |
| `var(--accent-ink)` | `#FAF9F5` | text on accent. Ivory, not pure white |
| `var(--accent-hover)` | `#143028` | primary button hover. Darken, never brighten |
| `var(--tag-quiet)` | `#E7EFE9` | receding tag fill |
| `var(--tag)` | `#D9E6DE` | default tag fill |
| `var(--danger)` | `#B53333` | errors only. Not a brand color |
| `var(--dark)` | `#141413` | dark band base. Only when a brief asks |
| `var(--dark-surface)` | `#30302E` | containers on dark |
| `var(--accent-on-dark)` | `#8FBFAB` | links and labels on dark |

## themes

Set `<html data-theme="name">`. One theme per page. Hover, tags and on-dark derive from the accent.

| theme | accent | feel |
|---|---|---|
| `emerald` | `#1C3D32` | default. Deep green |
| `garnet` | `#6B1E2E` | wine red |
| `amethyst` | `#4B2A63` | deep violet |
| `peacock` | `#134B52` | blue-green |
| `topaz` | `#6E430C` | bronze amber |
